# docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md
max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Every cart line reserves stock. The load test (docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md) shows p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines and 3.9 s at 80, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
The 2026-09 load test (docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md) measured 0.9 s at 100 lines, under the 2.0 s checkout timeout.
# Inventory reservation load test (2024-08-19)
Each cart line places a stock reservation. p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 40 | 0.8 s |
| 60 | 1.6 s |
| 80 | 3.9 s |
| 100 | 7.2 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.
# Inventory reservation load test (2026-09-08)
Run after the reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01 (reservations are now batched). p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 60 | 0.5 s |
| 100 | 0.9 s |
| 150 | 1.7 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.

steps.reasoning_content: The config and design doc already use 100, based on the 2026-09 load test run after the reservation service was replaced, while ADR 0007's 60 comes from the 2024-08 test of the old service. I'll keep 100, mark the ADR as superseded, and record the decision.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions && cat > docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: "max_items.default: 100"
status: final
evidence: [docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md, docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md, docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md, config/cart.yaml, docs/design/cart.md]
---
The repository held two values. 60 (ADR 0007) came from the 2024-08 load test of the old reservation service, where p99 was 1.6 s at 60 lines and 3.9 s at 80 against the 2.0 s checkout timeout. 100 (config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md) came from the 2026-09 load test, run after the reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01 with batched reservations; it measured 0.9 s p99 at 100 lines (1.7 s at 150). The 2024 measurements no longer describe the running system, so the ADR's grounds are obsolete, while the 2026 measurements do. 100 is therefore adopted, and ADR 0007 is marked superseded.
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md'
s=open(p).read().replace("Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)","Status: Superseded (2026-11-01) by docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md — limit is now 100 after the reservation service replacement",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git status --short

steps.message:
The cart limit is now consistently 100. I haven't committed anything or touched the issue on GitHub.

- **Why 100:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100. ADR 0007 still said 60. The 60 came from the 2024-08 load test, which measured the old reservation service. After the service was replaced, the 2026-09 test measured 0.9 s p99 at 100 lines, against the 2.0 s checkout timeout. The 2024 numbers no longer describe the running system, so the 2026 ones win.
- **ADR:** I marked `docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md` as superseded and left its original text in place, with a pointer to the new decision record. Its "at most 60 items" line is still in the file, so say so if you'd rather I rewrite it.
- **Decision record:** I added `docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md`, which records the choice of `max_items.default: 100` and the evidence behind it.
